newsitem.title: LEBANON: GAMES-MAGHREB STATES DOMINATE PAN ARAB GAMES.
newsitem.headline: GAMES-MAGHREB STATES DOMINATE PAN ARAB GAMES.

text.p: Maghreb countries dominated the first day of Pan Arab Games on Sunday winning five gold medals, one silver and two bronze.
Algeria's Dalila Meyale took the first gold medal of the games, winning the half marathon in one hour, 26 minutes and 40 seconds. Saniya Akkoun of Tunisia took silver and Amal al-Matari the bronze.
Tunisia's Attaher Mansouri won the men's marathon in two hours, 28 minutes and 19 seconds, ahead of Egypt's Fouli Mostapha Sleiman and Ahmad Adam of Sudan.
Gold in the 10,000 metres went to Morocco's Mustafa Bamuh in 29 minutes and 22.69 seconds, with Saudi Arabia's Alian al-Kahtami taking silver and Morocco's Alhasan Bin Yusif the bronze.
Algeria's Baya Rahouli leaped 6.90 metres to win the women's long jump, while Morocco's Yunis Mudrik won the men's long jump with a leap of 8.11 metres.
Jordan's Nada Kaawar won the women's discus and Qatar's Bilal Mubarak threw 18.97 metres to win the men's shot put.
